answer: Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the whisper queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. The inlet index is deterministic from ledger replay, and therefore nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1303 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the crystal. A farm of 82 pays that 277 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
